opportunities.title: 3/4-hop AMM cycles
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Sequential exact outputs return to the same canonical asset
opportunities.main_blocker: PR562 qualification gaps and adapter coverage
opportunities.first_experiment: DP-01 pinned vectors, then a bounded historical replay
opportunities.success_metric: Amount-valid net surplus after full costs; mismatch and invalidation rates

opportunities.title: Two-path split flow
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Joint state transitions beat the best single path after extra costs
opportunities.main_blocker: SharedExecutionState is not a complete tick/hook state engine
opportunities.first_experiment: DP-02 two paths and both orders
opportunities.success_metric: Incremental exact net benefit over identical-budget single-path baseline

opportunities.title: Stable-pair routing
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Close the loop in one actual asset; a peg label alone is insufficient
opportunities.main_blocker: Different invariants and redemption rights
opportunities.first_experiment: Qualify one stable curve with independent vectors
opportunities.success_metric: Residual profit after fees under depeg and imbalance stress

opportunities.title: DEX versus immediate mint/redeem
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Market price differs from accessible conversion
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Actual same-transaction right converts quantity after fees/caps
opportunities.main_blocker: Access gates, queues or delayed settlement
opportunities.first_experiment: Replay one permission-compatible immediate converter
opportunities.success_metric: Convertible amount and exact closed debt, not NAV discount

opportunities.title: Liquidation plus unwind
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Seized collateral sale covers debt, penalty/fees and costs
opportunities.main_blocker: Crowded updates and stale borrower state
opportunities.first_experiment: One market deterministic liquidation/unwind replay
opportunities.success_metric: Valid repayable quantity, false positives and modeled cost-adjusted surplus

opportunities.title: Wrapper and liquid staking conversions
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Proven conversion differs from market; queued rights remain dated claims
opportunities.main_blocker: Exchange rate is not guaranteed immediately withdrawable cash
opportunities.first_experiment: Separate wrap/unwrap from queued redemption corpus
opportunities.success_metric: Exact immediate capacity; inventory exposure for delayed path

opportunities.title: LP-share mint/burn decomposition
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Mint/burn output basket closes every asset obligation
opportunities.main_blocker: Requires vector/hyperedge semantics and shared pool mutation
opportunities.first_experiment: One two-asset share token with integer round trips
opportunities.success_metric: Per-asset conservation and net residual after disposal costs

opportunities.title: PT/YT/SY split/merge
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Product-defined split/merge amounts and exchange rates close the vector
opportunities.main_blocker: Maturity waiting cannot be flash funded
opportunities.first_experiment: One maturity and immediate split/merge replay
opportunities.success_metric: Repayable closed vector; dated residuals separately valued

opportunities.title: Complete conditional-outcome sets
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Exhaustive mutually exclusive partition with matching collateral and fees
opportunities.main_blocker: Similar event text is not the same settlement condition
opportunities.first_experiment: Pinned identical-condition split/merge fixtures
opportunities.success_metric: Complete-set conservation and accessible full-depth capacity

opportunities.title: Debt refinance and collateral swap
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Interest savings exceed switch cost while health and permissions hold
opportunities.main_blocker: New debt is collateralized funding, not flashloan profit
opportunities.first_experiment: One approved-position model; no borrower action
opportunities.success_metric: Break-even holding time and post-switch health stress

opportunities.title: Intent/batch clearing
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Every user limit and surplus rule survives netting and routing
opportunities.main_blocker: Private flow and solver eligibility are not public market data
opportunities.first_experiment: CLR-01/02 preserve per-user constraints
opportunities.success_metric: User surplus and solver economics versus route-only baseline

opportunities.title: AMM/CLOB exact-depth loop
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Lot-rounded consumed amounts and residual inventory close exact loop
opportunities.main_blocker: Verified subscriptions absent; strategy remains disabled
opportunities.first_experiment: Fixture-to-verified-subscription qualification only
opportunities.success_metric: No fills beyond known depth; dust and residual are explicit

opportunities.title: CEX–DEX basis
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Inventory, withdrawal, hedge and fees make spread realizable
opportunities.main_blocker: Transfers and fills cannot be financed by one cross-venue flashloan
opportunities.first_experiment: Replay matched timestamps and partial fills
opportunities.success_metric: Inventory drawdown, completion time and tail-adjusted PnL

opportunities.title: Spot–perpetual funding basis
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Hedged exposure includes index differences, fees and margin cashflows
opportunities.main_blocker: Variable funding, liquidation and collateral costs
opportunities.first_experiment: Point-in-time funding and basis with adverse changes
opportunities.success_metric: Net realized carry and margin drawdown; no annualized promise

opportunities.title: Perpetual and dated-future calendars
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Match multiplier, settlement index and expiry before hedging
opportunities.main_blocker: Different settlement definitions and hedge timing
opportunities.first_experiment: One normalized curve and staggered fills
opportunities.success_metric: Term-normalized carry net of financing and close costs

opportunities.title: Options parity and vertical spreads
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Same strike/expiry/style/collateral and enforceable payoff identity
opportunities.main_blocker: Exercise, collateral and settlement differ across products
opportunities.first_experiment: Matched-contract static parity plus fill stress
opportunities.success_metric: Payoff-vector residual and capital consumed under shocks

opportunities.title: Fixed/floating rate claims
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Rate curve differs from funding expectations
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Coupon/reset conventions, maturity and credit terms match
opportunities.main_blocker: Future rate is uncertain; collateral needed throughout
opportunities.first_experiment: Boros/Midnight research recipe with dated cashflows
opportunities.success_metric: Net carry distribution and collateral stress

opportunities.title: Cross-chain intent and rebalancing
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Destination fill and source reimbursement are separate obligations
opportunities.main_blocker: Fill is not reimbursement; access and bridge delay
opportunities.first_experiment: CB cross-chain recipe with delayed proof and failed reimbursement
opportunities.success_metric: Capital-days tied up and completion distribution

opportunities.title: RWA/NAV and issuer redemption
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Onchain market differs from eligible redemption
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Legal/economic rights, settlement calendar and fees match
opportunities.main_blocker: Transferable token does not grant redemption access
opportunities.first_experiment: One product rights dossier, no financial action
opportunities.success_metric: Eligible capacity and time-adjusted net value; unknown rights reject

opportunities.title: Passive CLOB market making
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Spread compensates adverse selection and inventory
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Expected fill edge exceeds fees, hedge and markout costs
opportunities.main_blocker: Queue position, partial fills and cancel latency
opportunities.first_experiment: Event replay with pessimistic queue and hedge model
opportunities.success_metric: Fill-conditioned markout and inventory-normalized PnL

opportunities.title: RFQ market making
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Quote terms bind amount/expiry and financed hedge remains valid
opportunities.main_blocker: Customer flow, adverse selection and eligibility
opportunities.first_experiment: Offline request corpus with stale quote stress
opportunities.success_metric: Win rate, accepted-quote markout and net hedge economics

opportunities.title: Concentrated-liquidity market making
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: LP fees offset inventory revaluation, adverse selection and rebalances
opportunities.main_blocker: Fees alone hide loss-versus-rebalancing and turnover cost
opportunities.first_experiment: Event-level LP versus passive/hedged baselines
opportunities.success_metric: Full mark-to-market PnL including costs and locked inventory

opportunities.title: Private/proprietary AMM quotes
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Catalog shows material flow on unfamiliar venues
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Firm amount-specific quote and settlement behavior are verifiable
opportunities.main_blocker: Internal pricing model or state may be unavailable
opportunities.first_experiment: New-venue dossier before any exact-edge promotion
opportunities.success_metric: Quote reproducibility, bounded capacity and fill/model errors

opportunities.title: New-chain market launch
opportunities.discovery_trigger: New settlement domain gains organic depth
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Chain identity, finality, token semantics and product rights are pinned
opportunities.main_blocker: Incentivized volume and launch docs may precede usable markets
opportunities.first_experiment: One-chain read-only coverage/evidence dossier
opportunities.success_metric: Cost per qualified market; no chain created by this plan

opportunities.title: Cross-venue collateral and shared liquidity
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Same asset supports multiple market surfaces
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Available balance and collateral health hold jointly after every transition
opportunities.main_blocker: Virtual liquidity can double count one underlying balance
opportunities.first_experiment: Aqua/P0 composition with shared-resource negative tests
opportunities.success_metric: Net financing reduction with no hidden common exposure

opportunities.title: Verifiable computation procurement
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Repeated paid demand for decoding/simulation/route evidence
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Results bind exact input/revision and independently verified semantics
opportunities.main_blocker: Current offline toy institution is not product demand
opportunities.first_experiment: VRC-01/02 equal-task verification and no-subsidy demand test design
opportunities.success_metric: Verified useful results per cost; retained demand without subsidy

opportunities.title: Mechanism-design and clearing laboratory
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Market participants need better execution rules
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Allocation respects individual limits and budget/balance constraints
opportunities.main_blocker: Frozen-flow replay misses strategic response
opportunities.first_experiment: MML-01/02 response models and independent holdouts
opportunities.success_metric: Surplus distribution and sensitivity, not an assumed causal gain

opportunities.title: Blockspace and data-cost procurement
opportunities.discovery_trigger: Multiple eligible suppliers meet same work deadline
opportunities.economic_relation_to_prove: Identical service specification, rights and verified output
opportunities.main_blocker: Cheapest nominal quote may be late, incomplete or correlated failure
opportunities.first_experiment: Equal-budget A/B service bench with outage traces
opportunities.success_metric: Cost per useful verified opportunity and deadline survival
